metadata.title: Yaay 2K Subscribers! Thank you
metadata.description:
Though 2000 subscribers is not a big number. It's a big milestone for my channel 'Eat Your Kappa'. When I began this channel getting 20 subscribers seemed to be a really tough task. 

Thank you for all your support and encouragement through kind comments, that has been the fuel on which 'Eat Your Kappa' has been running. 

Thank you fellow youtubers for your support and thank you media houses for bringing to light my small channel. 

Following are some of the interesting channels from Northeast please do check them out:

Ruata Lungchuang - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNQxziZEvVVQKZEpnEyd6ow

A'chik tuber - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCADDtlSrQUsjsWhj7grSEDA

Foodieextreme - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdfXbs5EU_j8Jbi6EE2UYHg

For You - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfPWtyJ03I6_YuWCLQeB3oA

Also, following are the links to article on 'Eat Your Kappa';

Eclectic Northeast - https://eclecticnortheast.in/vlog-eat-kappa-taking-northeast-cuisine-world/

The Northeast Today - https://thenortheasttoday.com/in-search-of-passion-this-girl-from-shillong-quit-her-job-to-focus-on-her-youtube-cooking-channel/

Sheroes - https://sheroes.com/articles/i-work-six-months-and-travel-the-other-six/NTU5Mw==

TheBodotribe.com - http://www.thebodotribe.com/2017/07/eat-with-kappa-youtube-channel-taking.html

SnoozePost - https://snoozepost.com/eat-kappa-blog-made-pure-passion-dreams-brings-ne-cuisine-world/
